item.title: Springfield lottery player wins $100,000 scratchers prize
item.description: Someone won a $100,000 top prize in the Fat Wallet scratchers game in Springfield, with over $8.9 million in prizes won in Missouri since the ticket sales began.

item.title: Movie production transforms Branson, Silver Dollar City into Christmas wonderland for 2026 holiday film
item.description: BRANSON, Mo. — Cameras are rolling in Branson as production begins on An Ozark Mountain Christmas, a new holiday movie from Great American Media that will showcase Silver Dollar City and the Ozarks as a centerpiece of the network’s 2026 Christmas programming. The film, starring Brianna Cohen and Jonathan Stoddard, is being shot on location [...]

item.title: Fort Leonard Wood volunteer recognized as USO Volunteer of the Year
item.description: Loretta Streichert, a 22-year active-duty Army soldier and USO volunteer, has been selected as the 2025 USO Volunteer of the Year for her outstanding service to the military community.

item.title: Feel Old Yet? These 10 movies are turning 30 years old in 2026
item.description: Top 10 films from 1996, including Independence Day, Jerry Maguire, Scream, Mission: Impossible, Fargo, The Rock, Twister, Space Jam, Trainspotting, and Romeo + Juliet, are turning 30 years old this year.

item.title: Missouri Lottery player in Nixa celebrates $50,000 prize win
item.description: A Christian County lottery player won a $50,000 prize in the $1,000 Frenzy Scratchers game from a Nixa Walmart, with the game offering top prizes of $1 million and $50,000 second-tier prizes.

item.title: Springfield man gets 3 years for fatal crash in 2020
item.description: Brice Waddell was sentenced to three years in prison after pleading guilty to second-degree involuntary manslaughter for a 2020 crash that killed a pedestrian, Trampus Bell, who was found to have died from his injuries at a local hospital.

item.title: Construction set to begin on major Salvation Army campus expansion
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, MO - The Salvation Army is getting ready to start construction on a major campus expansion. In recent days, crews have placed construction fencing around a property on W. Chestnut Expressway next to the Salvation Army’s local headquarters. item.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo. — Governor Mike Kehoe has his sights on beginning the process of eliminating income taxes.
